summary: Fase 3 (Listini) frontend E2E tested via injected session tokens. Client order flow, wallet block/decrease, business itemized card, accept (no price for orders), and Segna consegnato (release) all work. Two frontend bugs found: (1) /listino screen for business with 2+ services does NOT auto-select first category (category state stays empty; user is loaded async but useState(services[0] || '') snapshots before user resolves) — user must manually tap the chip; (2) client Richieste tab crashes with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading status_preventivo)' when merged list contains a 'preventivo' status, preventing biz order cards from rendering.

ui_bugs.issue: When business has 2+ services, category is initialised via useState(services[0] || '') at first render — but AuthContext.user is loaded asynchronously, so services=[] at mount and category becomes ''. The screen then shows the category chips but 'Select a category' body and never auto-selects. User must manually tap a chip. Impact: seeded products not visible on entry. FIX: add useEffect(() => { if (!category && services.length) setCategory(services[0]); }, [services]). Reference: /app/frontend/app/listino/index.tsx:27

Crash 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading status_preventivo)' when rendering client list. Suggests t() lookup path returns undefined for statuses not present in either it/en dict (or LanguageContext not fully hydrated). Result: biz order cards do not render in Richieste for client (0 cards, held/cancel not visible). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/richieste.tsx:19 and /app/frontend/src/context/LanguageContext.tsx:29. FIX: add missing keys status_preventivo/status_matched/status_declined/status_confirmed/status_completed etc. to both it & en, or make t() null-safe: return strings?.[lang]?.[k] ?? strings?.en?.[k] ?? k;

integration_issues.flow: Client Richieste tab — order card + held amount + cancel
integration_issues.issue: Backend returns the order correctly (verified via wallet decrease and business seeing itemized card); frontend crashes prevent the client from viewing/held-amount/cancelling from Richieste. Blocks the 'cancel pending order (refund)' UX flow.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props detected (console warning). Migrate to boxShadow (RN 0.76+). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card, shadow.float).
Deprecated props.pointerEvents — use style.pointerEvents instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:182 (<View style={styles.floatWrap} pointerEvents="box-none">).

action_items: Fix ListinoScreen category auto-selection: add useEffect syncing category with user.services when services becomes non-empty (or use user?.services?.[0] directly in effect).

Fix Richieste crash 'status_preventivo': add all status_* i18n keys for both it & en (status_preventivo, status_confirmed, status_declined, status_cancelled, status_pubblicata, status_in_matching, status_con_proposte, status_confermata, status_in_corso, status_recensita, status_scaduta, status_annullata, status_matched, status_completed, status_pending, status_booked, status_in_progress, status_disputed), OR make t null-safe. This blocks the client cancel/held-amount UX.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to remove deprecation warnings.
Replace <View pointerEvents="..."> with style.pointerEvents in home screen.
critical_code_review_comments: ListinoScreen initializes state from user?.services on first render only — this is a common React pitfall. Should sync via useEffect.
LanguageContext t() lookups do not guard against undefined language dicts; StatusPill assumes every status has a translation.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (Listino cat auto-select): user context resolves after component mount; useState(services[0] || '') captures the empty snapshot and doesn't update. Bug 2 (Richieste crash): 'preventivo' status is used in the status color map (line 17) but no status_preventivo key exists in i18n it/en dicts. When another mission from a different service (e.g. artigiani proposta) returns status='preventivo', StatusPill's translation call chain fails since either the lang dict returns undefined for the key or the fallback t() itself crashes. Both bugs are simple 1-line fixes.
